row.evidence: Soldo's help centre says 'Soldo SSO doesn’t support automatic user provisioning. Users must already exist in Soldo with a matching email address.'
row.notes: New row. No SCIM: help-centre search for 'scim', 'okta' and 'azure' returns nothing, the developer portal (llms.txt) has no SCIM endpoints, and the SSO guide says SSO does not provision users. Prices are GBP from the en-gb pricing page (no USD list found): Standard £27/mo +VAT and Plus £39/mo +VAT are flat plan prices that start with 3 users; Unlimited is price on request. The pricing table shows SSO not available on Standard and as an add-on on Plus and Unlimited (add-on price not listed); the help article 'What is SSO?' says Unlimited only (see conflicts). Soldo Business API is an add-on on Plus and included on Unlimited, so api_tax is true. HRIS integrations (Unlimited add-on) can onboard and de-provision leavers automatically. Status none (rule 2: SSO only, no SCIM). okta.com/integrations/soldo/ and Entra gallery tutorials return 404; Entra SSO is a custom non-gallery app.

capabilities.notes: User status values in the schema include ACTIVE, INACTIVE, BLOCKED, SUSPENDED, PENDING, ARCHIVED, set via PUT .../status.

rate_limits.text: 600 requests per minute and 20 requests per second; 429 when exceeded.

entra.notes: Configured as a custom 'Create your own application' SAML app (OIDC also recommended); no Entra gallery tutorial found (404).

fallbacks.other_sync: HRIS integrations (Standard/Advanced/Bespoke, Unlimited add-on) onboard starters and de-provision leavers
